notes.title: Mountains Playtest
notes.content:
[b]Heyo! [/b]

The Mountain Island is ready for playtesting!

This playtest includes a new environment, new enemy faction, new hero, a new shove mechanic and various improvements to things like action inspection, damage previews, enemy performance and more!

Make sure to let us know how you feel about this playtest by using the in-game feedback system or joining our Discord server!

[b]Happy Dobbeling![/b]
- Jim & Michelle

notes.title: Patch 0.4.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed some missing LODs.
[*]Forced a minimum of 2 bridges to be generated in escort missions with a river.
[*]Fixed an issue where Cauterize was classified as a melee attack, which could cause buffs like 'Flame Blade' to make it deal damage on top of healing.
[*]Implemented a 'marble bag' system for level layout templates to ensure maximum level variety during a single run.
[*]Fixed porc flags visually not appearing in levels despite physically being there.
[*]Implemented a new grid evaluation system for enemies to determine where to move when they can't get within attack range. This solves an issue where occasionally an enemy would just stay still somewhere in the distance. 
[*] Made sure map edge fog is always being resized to match actual level boundaries.
[/list]

notes.title: Polish Patch
notes.content:
This update contains a whole bunch of both major and minor polish tweaks like sound effects, ui animations, bugfixes etc. 

[b]Noteworthy changes:[/b]
[list]

[*] Added custom music to all scenes
[*] Added / overhauled voice sounds for pretty much all characters except porcs
[*] Implemented a 'thanks' response system when a character receives a positive effect
[*] Added sound & animation to party customization screen
[*] Added sound & animation to shop screen
[*] Implemented dialogue sound
[*] Added sound to intro cutscene
[*] Added a demo notice on startup
[*] Tweaked 'action cam' to be less jarring, particularly when zoomed out
[*] Tweaked screen shakes
[*] Removed 3D characters from pause screen
[*] Added sound & improved animations to battle result screens
[*] Added cinematic bars during cinematics
[*] Implemented a 'friendly' targeting color (movement, hostile & friendly actions now all have their own colors)
[*] Implemented a first 'instant skill refund' system when selecting a purchased skill (this will also immediately refund any skills that depended on that skill, which could cascade into a whole tier being refunded. Better warning / management systems for this will be implemented later)
[*] Added 'new' indicators to skill & equipment tabs
[*] Added Drag & Drop functionality to inventory
[*] Loading screen character animation now use prerendered sprite animations instead of 3D renders, fixing some issues that caused on various resolutions
[*] Health bars are now hidden by default and only appear when deemed 'relevant' (more settings for this will follow)
[*] Rebuilt the settings screen to be more controller-friendly
[*] Improved dice vfx & sound
[*] Implemented fancier 'end of demo' popup
[*] Tweaked clay shader textures to be more in-line with marketing material
[*] Implemented a new 'style detection' system for action / buff descriptions that automatically recolors relevant parts of a description.
[*] Updated credits
[*] Implemented 'happy / sad' animations for characters in battle result screen
[*] Updated tutorial messages
[*] Implemented a new sequence for when you failed too many missions to continue in the overworld
[*] Fixed & improved wagon explosions
[*] Improved overworld node reveal sequence
[*] Minor VFX tweaks here and there
[/list]

[b]Noteworthy fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed breaking issue when an enemy spawned on top of a bear trap
[*] Fixed breaking issue with certain overworld node outlines that could cause the game to get stuck on the loading screen
[*] Fixed breaking issue that could trigger when the windmill took damage
[*] Fixed some issues regarding being able to continue a game where the tutorial battle was still in-progress
[/list]

This will be the last major update to the playtest before the demo goes live.

[b]Happy Dobbeling![/b]
[i]- Jimbo[/i]

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworked level mesh combining systems, providing a significant performance boost in battles.
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed porc brute visual misalignment in some Rescue levels
[*] AOE ranges now strictly adhere to grid-distance rules again, rather than following custom patterns.
[*] Fixed upgrade cost visibility issue when one or more heroes had fully upgraded a particular skill.
[*] Fixed an issue with shapeshifting in a chicken run level which resulted in certain actions not being properly initialized in the shapeshifted hero.
[*] Non-hero player characters (e.g. imp, wolf) can now interact with chickens properly (Note: They still lack proper animations for these interactions)
[*] (Temporarily) Removed the ‘rescue all chickens’ bonus objective because it was incompatible with the way we currently resolve the main quest objectives.
[*] Buildings (porc tent, windmill) now properly block line of sight.
[*] The version display now shows the correct version number.
[*] Action cam now properly handles the Reinforcements action.
[/list]

notes.title: 🎲 Playtest 2 is now live! 🎲
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44874165/84ab87f91ce5a44fa234bfcb40402fe72003f680.png[/img]
[b]Heyo![/b]

I'm happy to share we've just released our second playtest build, which primarily focuses on quest variety by adding more quest types and bonus objectives!

During the last playtest, we experimented with adding elevation to some levels to see how that could impact Dobbel Dungeon's gameplay. In our opinion, while it added some visual flair, we found it didn't really add enough value to the gameplay itself to justify the additional system complexity and related issues that came with it, especially since we're only a 2-person team. So for this playtest, as another experiment, we've removed elevation from all levels to see how much it actually affects the fun-factor of the game. 

The playtest remains open, so make sure to request access and keep an eye on your email / steam library where it will pop up soon after!

[b]Primary Changes:[/b]
- New Quest: Defend
- New Quest: Escort
- New Quest: Chicken Run
- Revamped Quest: Attack
- Revamped Quest: Ambush
- Added a new enemy spawner in the form of Porc Tents
- Replaced railroad overworld movement with free movement
- Added audio settings
- Added more & tweaked existing action VFX
- Removed elevation from all levels
- Added an 'action cam' system to make sure action targets are always in-frame

[b]Happy Dobbeling![/b]
